native_comparison.scope: Simultaneous logical-model/native-Intel RAM comparison under the existing exhaustive 256-address primitive startup and independent-byte-lane workload, both read ports and output-enable hold. Native read-during-write/collision/unknown behavior is excluded and the logical models reject active same-word mixed-port writes. Not physical M10K or a complete system proof.

Production source lists keep the real Intel wrappers.
